items.q: The biggest honour and the most celebrated occasion we experienced was when our orchestra was engaged to play for the wedding reception for the marriage of Mohamed Riza Pahlevi... and Princess Fawzia

ctx.x: One young Egyptian jazz fan that we became well acquainted was called Mimi and his parents owned a very large farm on the outskirts of Alexandria. Mimi's father was a minister in the Egyptian government and was away from the farm quite often, and ever so often Mimi would give a party which would take place in the afternoons. There were two cabarets in Alexandria that engaged European girls as entertainers and Mimi who was a sort of playboy also, would invite some of the girls to those parties and we all had a…

The biggest honour and the most celebrated occasion we experienced was when our orchestra was engaged to play for the wedding reception for the marriage of Mohamed Riza Pahlevi, the crown Prince of Iran (who became later the Shah of Iran) and Princess Fawzia, the sister of King Farouk.

The wedding and reception took place in Cairo on the 15th of March 1939. Unfortunately the reception did not take place in the Palace of the King which would have been very exciting to have visited a part of. But it was in a very large mansion near the centre of the city. The orchestra was placed on the landing of a large staircase just a few steps down from the room where the reception took place.
